name: kedah-community-connect
description: Kedah Community Connect (KCC) — Cloud-first community issue reporting and service-tracking platform

scripts.dev: npm run dev:worker & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm --workspace=packages/shared run build && npm --workspace=apps/worker run build && npm --workspace=apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=packages/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=apps/worker run typecheck && npm --workspace=apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace=packages/shared run test && npm --workspace=apps/worker run test && npm --workspace=apps/web run test
